summary: Multi-tenant metering discrepancy observed after decommission of regional edge proxy
description:
Issue summary:
BrightCart reported that their consolidated invoice shows a 42% higher hosted usage line for the billing window 2026-02-28 00:00:00 to 2026-03-01 00:00:00 UTC. They believe excess usage was attributed to their production org after we decommissioned an older regional edge proxy (edge-us-east-3) last week.

Impact:
- Customer seeing ~3.8k USD unexpected hosted usage charge on finalized invoice for the period.
- Affects billing reconciliation for finance (BrightCart) and may trigger chargeback to their customers.
- Customer service and engineering time required to arbitrate.

Environment:
- Redwood prod, region us-east (primary), eu-west (secondary failover).
- Customer uses dedicated hybrid routing with private keys and multiple subaccounts under org-brightcart-prod.

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Decommissioned edge proxy edge-us-east-3 on 2026-02-27 14:05 UTC (scheduled maintenance).
2) Post-decommission, queued postbacks for several API keys were replayed from retention buffer over a short window (2026-02-27 14:10–14:40 UTC).
3) BrightCart reports that the postbacks were attributed to their parent org rather than the original subaccount that produced them.
4) Metering pipeline aggregated those postbacks into hourly buckets and rerated them under hosted tariff, not reserved/dedicated tags.

Expected behavior:
- Postback replay should preserve original api_key and subaccount tags, maintain original rate/tariff mapping, and attribute usage to original org/subaccount.

Actual behavior:
- A subset (~18%) of replayed postbacks lost subaccount tagging during replay and were attributed to BrightCart parent org at hosted rates.

Logs / evidence available:
- Postback trace IDs: pb-ff7a1c, pb-ff7a1d, pb-ff7a4a (attached).
- Edge decommission runbook: Confluence page 'Edge decommission: edge-us-east-3' (link in related_confluence_pages).
- Consolidated invoice PDF (BrightCart March cycle) attached by customer.

Immediate customer request:
- Provide explanation and provisional credit for the unexpected hosted charge while we investigate attribution.

Workaround suggested to customer (temporary):
- Disable postback retry replay from retention for org-brightcart-prod until tagging fix is deployed.

Notes on severity and routing:
- Finance-impacting, escalate to Billing SRE and Postback team.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Ticket opened from BrightCart support channel. Customer provided invoice PDF and three example postback trace IDs. Escalating to billing and postback_reconciler teams.

2026-03-10 10:03 - Oliver Grant (Billing): Ack'd. Pulling billing ledger for org-brightcart-prod window 2026-02-28. Noted hosted-rate lines tied to invoice lines INV-20260301-BRIGHT. Investigating rate_id mapping.

2026-03-10 13:45 - Priya Menon (Postback SRE): Observed replay bursts in retention-replayer logs around 2026-02-27T14:10Z. Several events show missing 'subaccount_id' key prior to handoff to metering service. Filing hypothesis that edge proxy decommission script didn't forward headers consistently.

2026-03-11 08:22 - Riley Chen (Billing Engineer): Cross-referenced postbacks with hourly aggregators. Confirmed ~1,240 tokens metered under parent org at hosted tariff that should have been metered under reserved prefix. Preparing provisional credit calculation (~3,800 USD).
2026-03-11 11:05 - BrightCart (Customer): Thanks — would like provisional credit before 2026-03-15 close of their accounting month. Please advise timeline for fix and whether this will recur.

2026-03-11 14:30 - Priya Menon (Postback SRE): Deployed hotfix to retention-replayer to preserve 'subaccount_id' fallback when header absent. Added additional validation and a short audit job to reconcile recent replays. Will run reconciliation and produce mapping file.

2026-03-12 09:00 - Riley Chen (Billing Engineer): Reconciliation run complete. Found 1,215 postbacks misattributed. Drafting credit memo for finance QA. Proposed resolution: apply provisional credit of 3,821.60 USD to BrightCart account and reissue corrected invoice line in next billing cycle.

2026-03-12 12:10 - Aisha Patel (Support): Updated customer with provisional credit plan and temporary mitigation (disabled retention replay for their org). Customer acknowledged and asked for postmortem once reconciler report is ready.
investigation_notes: Retention-replayer lacked strict validation of X-Subaccount header when edge decommissioned; some proxies stripped header during graceful shutdown.
Metering service applied fallback routing that defaults to parent org if subaccount tag missing — this logic is correct for isolated events but unsafe for bulk replays.
Related to edge decommission run: automated failover path used an older proxy configuration that didn't include the subaccount propagation middleware (commit a124f3c on infra-edge repository).
Reconciler audit matched original postback body to aggregated meter events by trace_id and timestamp; 1,215 events misattributed out of 6,720 replayed (~18%).
resolution: Billing and Postback teams applied a provisional credit of 3,821.60 USD to BrightCart's account (pending finance QA). Hotfix deployed to retention-replayer to preserve subaccount headers during replay. Reconciler mapping applied to rerate and re-attribute affected usage; corrected invoice will be issued in next cycle with corresponding explanation. Follow-up actions: (1) postmortem to be published to Confluence, (2) add unit test and integration test for header preservation in edge decommission scripts, (3) add alert for sudden bulk replays that lack subaccount tags.
